requirements.requirement: Relate perturbations to exact componentwise products x_i*y_i.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:8-9 defines exactProductTree by p.1 * p.2; lines 95-97 use this exact tree as the original in IsPerturbation. Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:17-23 enforces matching shape and |perturbed leaf - exact product| ≤ bound * |exact product|.

requirements.requirement: Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:12-17 defines one model.mul per leaf followed by roundedSum; Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:26-27 defines mul as round (a*b). Submission.lean:41-51 and 56-66 apply round_spec to the exact product and bound its one rounding error.

requirements.requirement: Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
requirements.evidence: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:11-13 rounds addition at every internal node. Research/Submission.lean:68-87 recurses on both children, applies round_spec to their rounded sum, and scales both perturbed subtrees by the new factor, preserving the result equality. Tree.lean:21-23 counts internal nodes along the longest leaf path.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:30-87 proves a budget of k additions plus one multiplication using gamma (k+1) u. Each node uses gamma_step (k+1) at lines 79-82 to advance the bound by one error; lines 98-99 specialize k to tree.depth. Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Gamma.lean:8-9 defines gamma k u = k*u/(1-k*u), and lines 33-54 prove the accumulation inequality under the proper smallness condition.

requirements.requirement: Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:91-99 has no hypotheses beyond an arbitrary Model, an arbitrary pair tree, and the requested smallness condition. Model.lean:15-19 supplies only nonnegative u and the stated relative-error rounding specification. The helper depth bound is discharged by le_rfl. No exact-arithmetic or conclusion assumption occurs; independent Lean reports only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound as theorem axioms.
